title_sq: Shitet Apartament 2+1 te Zogu i Zi Shitet apartament 2+1 me siperfaq
description_sq:
Shitet Apartament 2+1 te Zogu i Zi
Shitet apartament 2+1 me siperfaqe totale 100 m2 (neto dhe bruto).
Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e dyte te nje objekti 6 katesh te ndertuar ne vitet 2000,shume prane rrethrrotullimit te Zogut te zi.
Apartamenti eshte i organizuar ne 1 sallon+kuzhine,1 tualet,dhe 2 dhoma gjumi.
Orinetimi i sallonit eshte nga jugu dhe dhomat kane orientim nga veriu.
Fasada nga veriu ka dukshmeri plotesisht buze rruges "Mine Peza",element qe i jep prones mundesine te kthehet ne nje aktivitet biznesi.
Prona disponon Certifikate Pronesie.
Shitet me cmimin:213.000 Euro.
title_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Zogu i Zi. 2+1 apartment with surface for sale
description_en: 2+1 apartment for sale in Zogu i Zi. 2+1 apartment for sale with a total area of ​​100 m2 (net and gross). The apartment is located on the second floor of a 6-story building built in the 2000s, very close to the Black Bird roundabout. The apartment is organized in 1 living room + kitchen, 1 bathroom, and 2 bedrooms. The orientation of the salon is from the south and the rooms are oriented from the north. The facade from the north has full visibility on the edge of "Mine Peza" street, an element that gives the property the opportunity to return to a business activity. The property has Ownership Certificates. For sale at the price: 213,000 Euros.
